title: After peacefully resolving Rook via the Scout-only option (quest 'The Rope Larder' marked Done), Rook still shows as '(hostile, holds its ground, hp8/8)' in the room, and the 'travel to a known place' fast-travel option disappears entirely from that room's menu — it is present in every adjacent room, before the resolution, and one step away at Fox Crossing. Forced a manual walk back out instead of a fast travel.
